title: Applied Researcher
job_description:
Applied Researcher

Join our social-impact research practice to turn community evidence into practical program improvements. You will lead research activities, protect participant data, and work with partners to interpret results.

Basic Qualifications
- Master’s degree in a social-science, public-policy, or related discipline.
- Experience conducting qualitative interviews and synthesizing themes.
- Experience with consent, anonymization, and responsible participant-data practices.
- Experience presenting research findings to community or program stakeholders.
- Experience managing institutional review board submissions.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience conducting literature reviews.
- Experience designing randomized controlled trials.
- Experience in clinical research.
